policies.qual: (has_permission('leads.read'::text) AND ((assigned_to IS NULL) OR (assigned_to = auth.uid()) OR has_permission('users.read'::text)))

policies.with_check: (has_permission('leads.write'::text) AND ((assigned_to IS NULL) OR (assigned_to = auth.uid()) OR has_permission('users.read'::text)))

policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM lead_attachments a
  WHERE ((a.media_id = media_assets.id) AND can_access_lead(a.lead_id))))

((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_media.product_id) AND (p.status = 'published'::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM media_assets m
  WHERE ((m.id = product_media.media_id) AND (m.visibility = 'public'::text)))))

((status = 'published'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_options.product_id) AND (p.status = 'published'::text)))))

((status = 'published'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_variants.product_id) AND (p.status = 'published'::text)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM quotations q
  WHERE ((q.id = quotation_versions.quotation_id) AND (q.status <> 'draft'::text) AND owns_customer(q.customer_id))))

constraints.name: private_invoice_pdf_only
constraints.definition: CHECK (format <> 'pdf'::text OR context = 'invoice'::text AND visibility = 'private'::text AND resource_type = 'image'::text AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: quotation_revision_metadata
constraints.definition: CHECK (revision_of IS NULL AND revision_key IS NULL AND revision_reason IS NULL AND revision_actor IS NULL OR revision_of IS NOT NULL AND revision_key IS NOT NULL AND length(revision_reason) >= 3 AND length(revision_reason) <= 500 AND revision_actor IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: catalog_video_only
constraints.definition: CHECK (resource_type = 'image'::text OR context = 'product'::text AND visibility = 'public'::text AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND lead_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: upload_actor
constraints.definition: CHECK (owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR lead_id IS NOT NULL)
